The Authentic Name of Oizýs

Scholarly reference for Oizýs

Greek

Ὀιζύς

The name in its original Greek form. Ὀιζύς carries the full phonetic and orthographic weight of the source tradition.

ASCII Constraint

OIZYS

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Oizýs

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
oizýs.com → xn--oizs-7ra.com

The non-ASCII characters in Oizýs are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Oizýs. PUNICODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Saying It
oy-ZDEES · /oj. ˈzdys/

Derived from restored orthography (classical Attic values).

Tier Classification

Why Oizýs is classified as Tier-1

The Greek original Ὀιζύς contains both stress AND at least one long vowel, and one historically dominant Unicode restoration exists. This is the full scholarly orthography — a single-tier Tier-1 name.
